-- Add tags to projects with fewer than 5 tags
-- Batch 1: Recent projects

-- Sweeney Todd (2023) - add Musical Theatre, Dark Musical, Victorian London, Revenge, Stephen Sondheim
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Sweeney Todd' 
  AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', 'Dark Musical', 'Victorian London', 'Revenge', 'Stephen Sondheim', '2023')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
